summary: Metadata spoofing in reconnect platform/deviceFamily fields bypasses platform-based node command policies
notes: Requires paired node identity on trusted network. Reconnect metadata (platform, deviceFamily) not bound into device-auth signature, allowing spoofed reconnect to bypass platform-based command policies.

summary: Path traversal in $include directive allows reading arbitrary local files outside config directory
notes: The $include directive in OpenClaw config files resolves paths without proper boundary checking. Attackers with config modification privileges can use absolute paths, traversal sequences (../), or symlinks to read sensitive files (API keys, credentials) readable by the OpenClaw process user.
